      applicationID 6

      modulationTypeMajor 14
      modulationTypeSpreadSpectrum 15
      modulationTypeSystem 16
      networkMode "networkWriter"
      port 41236
      power 17.5
      radioEntityTypeCategory 18
      radioEntityTypeCountry 19
      radioEntityTypeDomain 20
      radioEntityTypeKind 21
      radioEntityTypeNomenclature 22
      radioEntityTypeNomenclatureVersion 23
      radioID 24
      relativeAntennaLocation 4 5 6
      siteID 25
      transmitFrequencyBandwidth 26.5

  }
